blocks.html:
Delete Section 2.1.3 and replace as follows:
2.1.3 Hangers shall be spaced a maximum of 4'-6" (1372 mm) on center. Each hanger shall be capable of supporting the suspended load in accordance with the provisions of this code. If local situations require greater center distances between hangers, the load-carrying capacity of the ceiling suspension system shall be reduced commensurate with the actual center-to-center hanger distances used.
